about_the_game:
The latest suspects to join Clue/Cluedo have been invited by…you! 

You asked, we delivered – the iconic 2016 Clue/Cluedo characters make their grand return to the digital board game. Play with your favourite suspect from the 2016 edition, taking them to the updated Tudor Mansion or any of the new crime scenes you own! 

The 2016 characters aren’t tied to any character tasks or crime scenes, leaving you free to enjoy them as an entirely nostalgic experience. 

Get the 2016 Suspect pack – with twelve tokens to choose from – and add a touch of timelessness to your next game of Clue/Cluedo! 

INCLUDES:

  • 2 x MISS SCARLETT (2016) TOKENS – The beautiful long-time friend of Boddy returns to the board.

  • 2 x COLONEL MUSTARD (2016) TOKENS – The decorated military officer marches into the modern Tudor Mansion!

  • 2 x DR ORCHID (2016) TOKENS – Boddy’s adoptive daughter with a poisonous past comes home.

  • 2 x REVEREND GREEN (2016) TOKENS – The reverend blesses Clue/Cluedo with his presence once more. 

  • 2 x MRS PEACOCK (2016) TOKENS – Never one to miss a party, socialite Mrs Peacock joins the game again!

  • 2 x PROFESSOR PLUM (2016) TOKENS – The archaeologist hopes to unearth more secrets in his next social excavation…
